<module id="multi_pipe_4bit">
    <description>4-bit unsigned number pipeline multiplier.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[3:0]">Multiplicand input.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[3:0]">Multiplier input.</input>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">Product output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="size">4</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="mul_a_ext" value="'d0 + mul_a" width_description="[7:0]">Extended multiplicand.</assign>
        <assign id="mul_b_ext" value="'d0 + mul_b" width_description="[7:0]">Extended multiplier.</assign>
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <genvar id="i" />
        <generate>
            <for start="0" end="size-1" step="1">
                <if condition="mul_b[i] == 1'b1">
                    <assign id="partial_product_i" value="mul_a_ext << i" width_description="[7:0]" />
                </if>
                <else>
                    <assign id="partial_product_i" value="'d0" width_description="[7:0]" />
                </else>
            </for>
        </generate>
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="register_sum[0]" value="'d0" width_description="[7:0]" />
        <reg id="register_sum[1]" value="'d0" width_description="[7:0]" />
        <reg id="register_sum[2]" value="'d0" width_description="[7:0]" />
        <always_comb>
            register_sum[0] <= 'd0;
            register_sum[1] <= 'd0;
            register_sum[2] <= 'd0;
            if (rst_n == 1'b0) begin
                register_sum[0] <= 'd0;
                register_sum[1] <= 'd0;
                register_sum[2] <= 'd0;
            end else begin
                register_sum[0] <= partial_product_0;
                register_sum[1] <= register_sum[0] + partial_product_1;
                register_sum[2] <= register_sum[1] + partial_product_2;
            end
        </always_comb>
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="mul_out" value="'d0" width_description="[7:0]" />
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                mul_out <= 'd0;
            end else begin
                mul_out <= register_sum[2];
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
</module>
